pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Needs 5 V for the heater (about 150 mA): use VIN

pins.name: DO
pins.notes: Threshold output. Its HIGH level is 5 V: use a voltage divider

pins.name: AO
pins.notes: Can reach 5 V: use a voltage divider before the ADC

sources.title: Hanwei MQ-7 datasheet
sources.section: CO sensing needs a 5 V / 1.4 V heater cycle; modules heat at a constant 5 V, so readings are only rough

sources.title: Hanwei MQ-7 datasheet
sources.section: Needs a burn-in / warm-up time before readings are stable
